findings.evidence: `FixedPoints.subring B G : Subring B` needs only `[Ring B] [Monoid G] [MulSemiringAction G B]` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Subalgebra/Operations.lean:98) and has the same carrier as `FixedPoints.subalgebra` (line 106-107, both built from `FixedPoints.subsemiring`); Mathlib already provides `SMulCommClass G (FixedPoints.subring B G) B` (line 102) and `Algebra.ofSubsemiring (S : C) : Algebra S A` (Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Basic.lean:101). `Spec.algebraMap (R A : Type u)` (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Scheme.lean:490) is the only source of the `R`/`A` universe coupling.
findings.fix: Define `quotient A G := Spec (CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subring A G))` and `projection A G := Spec.algebraMap (FixedPoints.subring A G) A`, drop `R` from everything above line 164, and introduce `(R) [CommRing R] [Algebra R A] [SMulCommClass G R A]` as a local variable for `projection_structureMap` and the `IsFinite` instance only. State the new `Algebra.IsInvariant` instance at the `FixedPoints.subring A G` level (keeping the subalgebra one for the Galois call site, which needs it).
findings.issue: `[Algebra R A] [SMulCommClass G R A]` and `R A : Type u` are imposed on the entire file, but `R` is mathematically load-bearing only in `projection_structureMap` (55) and the `IsFinite` instance (177, via `Algebra.FiniteType R A`). `quotient`, `projection`, `translate_projection`, `desc`, `hom_ext`, `existsUnique_desc`, `desc_projection`, the `IsIntegralHom`/`Surjective` instances, `isQuotientMap_projection` and `projection_eq_iff_exists_smul` all hold for a plain `MulSemiringAction G A` with no base ring. The result is a quotient scheme indexed by an irrelevant parameter: `quotient R A G` and `quotient R' A G` are formally different schemes for the same action, `R` is not inferable from the arguments of `desc` (hence the explicit `(R := R)` at 119), and a user whose base ring lives in another universe cannot instantiate the API at all.

summary: The invariant-quotient API threads a base ring `R` through all 18 declarations although only `projection_structureMap` and the `IsFinite` instance use it; the natural level is the base-free fixed subring. Separately, `finite_of_finiteType` bundles `Group G`/`Finite G`/`MulSemiringAction`/`IsInvariant` where `Algebra.IsIntegral S A` suffices, which forced the existing Galois call site to re-derive instances it already had.
